sovereign_country.strategic_role: 西欧核心消费市场、高客单价品牌合规与本土清关

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Vertical Industrial ERP and Customer Relationship Software

meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Civil Law (unitary national system with commercial code and administrative regulation)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: France–China Bilateral Investment Treaty (1984, in force 1985)
France–Germany Income Tax Convention (1959, as amended)
Treaty on the Functioning of the European Union, Articles 49 and 63 (right of establishment and free movement of capital)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Articles L. 223-1 et seq. of the French Commercial Code (SARL formation); Articles L. 561-1 et seq., L. 561-2-2, L. 561-10-2, L. 561-45 and R. 561-1 et seq. of the French Monetary and Financial Code; Decree No. 2021-320 transposing Directive (EU) 2018/843; French beneficial-owner register procedures administered through the INPI/Registre National des Entreprises and the registre du commerce et des sociétés; ACPR and French Financial Intelligence Unit (Tracfin) guidance.
ubo_and_aml_profiling.ubo_disclosure_level: Government_Only_Access (restricted to competent authorities, financial intelligence units and AML/CFT obliged entities with legitimate interest; no public internet bulk access following CJEU jurisprudence)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Home-country trade-register extract and certificate of good standing for each corporate shareholder, including its own UBO information
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent corporate registry or companies office of the shareholder's country of incorporation
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille where the issuer is a party to the Hague Convention; otherwise consular legalization by the French Embassy or Consulate followed by certified French translation

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Passport or national identity card of each UBO, proposed French gérant and any individual signatory
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: National passport authority, competent police authority, prefecture or consular service of the person's nationality
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarized certified copy; where required by the French bank or registrar, Hague Apostille or consular legalization of the notarial certification plus sworn French translation

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Power of attorney appointing the formation agent and, where applicable, the proposed French gérant
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Fully executed by each shareholder, UBO or the corporate shareholder's legal representative, notarized where required
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or consular legalization according to the country of execution, followed by certified French translation

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Declaration of acceptance of office as gérant and statement of no prohibition against acting as a manager
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Proposed gérant before a French notary or before the competent notarial authority in the gérant's country of residence
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or consular legalization plus certified French translation

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Proof of registered office or commercial domiciliation agreement for the SARL's siège social
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Owner of the premises, property lessor or licensed French commercial domiciliation company
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: No apostille required if executed in France; notarization and apostille/consular legalization may be required if executed overseas or if the holder is a foreign legal entity; certified French translation if in a foreign language

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all UBOs, shareholders, gérants, authorized signatories and counterparties against the European Union consolidated asset-freeze lists under Regulations (EU) No 269/2014 and 2580/2001, the UN Security Council consolidated list, the French national asset-freeze measures under the Monetary and Financial Code, and, where a USD or US nexus exists, the OFAC SDN List. Politically exposed person determination is required under Directive (EU) 2018/843 and Article L. 561-5-1 of the Monetary and Financial Code. Any match, proximity match, PEP status or adverse negative-news result triggers enhanced due diligence, senior-management approval and ongoing transaction monitoring in accordance with French AML/CFT obligations.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: INPI Guichet des Formalités de l'Entreprise (formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr) and the Registre National des Entreprises search portal (data.inpi.fr / annuaire-entreprises.data.gouv.fr)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Corporate formation documents must be filed in French, and the registered corporate name (dénomination sociale) is recorded in the RNE in Latin characters. Non-French names may be accepted but must be transliterated into Latin script; mandatory French-language versions are required for the articles of association, legal announcement and all official filings. If a non-Latin script is used commercially, an official administrative transliteration standard must be provided and kept consistent with the RNE record.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: If the proposed name is rejected, the applicant receives a written grounds notice through the INPI guichet unique mailbox. The applicant may cure the defect and resubmit without penalty. If the rejection is due to a prohibited or sensitive token, prior authorization from the competent authority (e.g. ACPR for banking/insurance tokens) may be obtained and the filing resubmitted. Where the applicant considers the rejection erroneous, a reasoned appeal may be filed with the INPI assistance and registration service within one month of the rejection notice; if the administrative review is unsuccessful, judicial recourse lies before the commercial chamber of the competent Tribunal judiciaire, which must be initiated within fifteen days of the final refusal, applying summary and interim procedures where there is urgency.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Commercial domiciliation is permitted for a SARL registered office, but a purely virtual mailbox without a physical address, a signed domiciliation contract or an ability to receive binding legal and administrative notices will not satisfy INPI/RCS, bank KYC or tax substance requirements. For an ERP/CRM vertical cloud business, the registered office must have sufficient French administrative substance, including accessible records and a French contact presence, while tax residence and permanent establishment analysis remains driven by effective management and operational facts.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low for a standard-risk ISIC 6201 vertical cloud software SARL; unannounced on-site inspection by French tax authorities or URSSAF is statutorily possible but is estimated at below 10% annual probability during the first three years absent tax anomalies, UBO/register inconsistencies, sanctions hits or other AML/CFT red flags. If high-risk indicators arise, including suspected undeclared French economic activity or fictitious registered office, inspection probability may rise materially above 25%.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Pre-incorporation legal due diligence, name clearance report, UBO/AML/CFT and sanctions screening
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: External French law firm (avocat) acting as pre-incorporation counsel
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark fixed fee for a low-risk French SARL

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: RNE/INPI name availability search and official category extracts
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: INPI/Registre National des Entreprises data operator and legal counsel
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory data/access fee plus nominal legal handling fee

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Apostille/consular legalization of foreign corporate, UBO, identity and manager documents and certified French translations
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Foreign competent apostille/legalization authorities, French consular posts and French court-appointed sworn translators
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory consular/apostille tariffs and regulated sworn-translation professional tariffs

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Drafting, review and execution of the SARL articles of association, management declarations and shareholder powers
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: French law firm or notaire where a notarized deed is required
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark fixed legal fee

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Official incorporation filing through the INPI guichet unique, RCS/RNE registration and statutory legal announcement publication in a French journal d'annonces légales
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: INPI/registre du commerce et des sociétés and the legal announcement newspaper publisher
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory registry/INPI fee and regulated publication tariff

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: First-year registered-office/commercial domiciliation agreement for the siège social
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark annual domiciliation fee

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: SIREN/SIRET coordination, post-incorporation VAT registration, and French bank/fintech onboarding due-diligence pack
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: INSEE, local tax office, and law firm/accountant coordinating registrations
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory registration at zero state charge for basic forms; professional coordination fee at prevailing market benchmark

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: French Commercial Code, including Articles L.223-1 to L.223-43 and R.223-1 to R.223-36 concerning SARL formation, management, capital, accounts, and corporate filings; Articles L.123-1 et seq. and R.123-1 et seq. concerning commercial registration and the National Business Register; Monetary and Financial Code provisions concerning beneficial-owner declarations.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: The National Business Formalities Portal operated by the Institut National de la Propriété Industrielle (INPI), with registration data transmitted to the competent commercial court registry (greffe du tribunal de commerce or designated commercial court registry).
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Electronic declaration of business creation submitted through the Guichet unique des formalités des entreprises, supported by signed SARL articles of association, registered-office evidence, management appointment, beneficial-owner declaration, and publication certificate for the legal notice of incorporation.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: A SARL may be formed with capital of EUR 1; there is no statutory minimum capital amount. For cash contributions, at least 20% of each subscribed contribution must be paid upon incorporation and the balance within five years of registration. Funds must generally be deposited with a bank, notary, or Caisse des dépôts et consignations before filing. No separate government escrow account is required. Registration, beneficial-owner, legal-notice, and professional fees are payable in euros and vary by filing and location; no fixed official state fee is stated in USD.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: FIRST MANAGEMENT RESOLUTION OF THE SARL. The sole shareholder or shareholders approve the subscription and payment of the share capital specified in the articles of association and confirm that the capital funds have been deposited with the designated depositary. The company adopts as its registered office the address stated in the articles of association, effective upon registration. The shareholders appoint [Name] as gérant for the statutory term, with authority to represent and bind the company within the limits of applicable law and the articles. The gérant is authorized to complete all INPI, registry, tax, banking, publication, and administrative formalities required for incorporation.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Confirm Founders, Capital, and Corporate Name
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Founder and corporate-service review; name availability checked through the INPI databases and, where relevant, the French trademark database.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Identify all shareholders, beneficial owners, proposed gérant, business activities, capital allocation, and registered office. Verify that the proposed name is not misleading or confusingly similar to an existing protected name. Determine whether any regulated activity is included in the corporate purpose. Obtain certified identity documents and, for corporate shareholders, current corporate extracts and authority evidence.
required_dossiers: Corporate shareholder registration extracts and constitutional documents, if applicable
Business activity description and corporate purpose
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name or activity is challenged, amend the name or corporate purpose before execution of the articles. If identity or ownership evidence is incomplete, obtain corrected certified copies and update the beneficial-owner analysis.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Selected French bank, notary, or Caisse des dépôts et consignations for capital deposit.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Prepare and sign the SARL articles of association, including capital, share distribution, management, registered office, corporate purpose, financial year, transfer restrictions, and decision procedures. Deposit at least 20% of each cash contribution and obtain the certificate of deposit of funds. Contributions in kind require valuation procedures and, where applicable, a commissaire aux apports report. Use French or attach an appropriate French translation for foreign-language evidence.
required_dossiers: In-kind contribution valuation report, if applicable
Powers of attorney, if signatories act through representatives
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Respond to the depositary's know-your-customer or source-of-funds query with ownership, identification, and banking evidence. Correct signature, capital, or valuation defects and obtain a replacement deposit certificate if required.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Authorized French legal-notice publication service in the department of the registered office.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a legal notice of incorporation containing the required SARL particulars, including name, legal form, capital, registered office, corporate purpose summary, duration, gérant identity, and registration details where available. Pay the applicable fixed or regulated publication charge and retain the publication certificate for the registration filing.
required_dossiers: Final signed articles or approved formation particulars
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Where the publisher rejects the notice, correct missing mandatory particulars and republish. If a material error is discovered after publication, issue a corrective notice and retain both certificates.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Guichet unique des formalités des entreprises at formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr, operated by INPI.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Create the electronic formation filing, select SARL, upload the signed articles, capital deposit certificate, registered-office evidence, legal-notice certificate, gérant declaration, identity documents, beneficial-owner information, and powers of attorney. Complete activity, tax, social-security, establishment, and correspondence fields accurately. Electronically sign, pay applicable charges, and download the submission receipt and tracking record.
required_dossiers: Gérant identity and declaration of non-conviction and filiation
French translations or legalization/apostille evidence, where required
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Monitor the INPI portal and respond within the stated deadline to any request for regularization. Upload replacement documents through the portal, correct inconsistent data, and retain the electronic receipt. An unresolved rejection may be challenged or resubmitted after correcting the stated defect.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Obtain Registration Evidence and Complete Post-Formation Governance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: INPI National Business Register and competent commercial court registry; applicable tax and social-security authorities.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Download the SIREN, SIRET, APE classification, and RNE registration evidence after acceptance. Open or activate the corporate bank account, transfer deposited capital, establish accounting records, register for VAT or other taxes where required, and implement payroll and social-security registrations if employees are hired. Maintain the signed articles, shareholder register, capital records, beneficial-owner data, management records, and annual accounts. Update the registry promptly after changes of gérant, office, activity, ownership, or beneficial ownership.
required_dossiers: RNE registration extract or equivalent registration evidence
Tax registration and VAT election evidence, if applicable
Payroll and social-security registrations, if applicable
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Correct registry or tax data through the relevant electronic service. Request rectification from the registry or competent authority where an administrative error persists, and preserve all filing receipts and correspondence.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: No sector-specific industrial licensing board is ordinarily required for ERP, CRM, and cloud software development or SaaS activities. Commercial and establishment formalities are handled through the INPI Guichet unique. The relevant municipality, prefecture, labour inspectorate, and fire-safety authorities may regulate the premises and workforce.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: No general manufacturing or industrial operating permit is required for ordinary software development, cloud-service administration, or business software licensing. Sector-specific authorization may arise if the activity separately involves telecommunications services, electronic money, payment services, health data hosting, critical infrastructure, or another regulated activity.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministry for Ecological Transition, through the competent regional environmental authority (Mission régionale d'autorité environnementale) and the relevant prefectural services.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Generally exempt from project-level environmental impact assessment for ordinary office-based software and SaaS operations. A screening or full assessment may apply only if the project includes construction, substantial site alteration, an industrial installation classified for environmental protection, significant water use, or another project listed under the French Environmental Code.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Ordinary office and software operations generally have no process wastewater, significant VOC emissions, or industrial air emissions. Comply with municipal wastewater rules, general waste and hazardous-waste traceability requirements, electrical and electronic equipment waste rules, and any applicable building or site permit conditions. Industrial discharges, emissions, storage, or classified installations require case-specific prefectural authorization or declaration and compliance with applicable prescribed limits.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: No industrial civil-defense clearance is ordinarily required for an office-based SARL. The premises must comply with French workplace health and safety requirements, including fire detection, evacuation routes, emergency access, electrical safety, and occupancy limits. If customers or other members of the public are admitted, the premises may constitute an établissement recevant du public and require applicable accessibility and fire-safety compliance, with municipal or departmental fire-safety review where required. Structural-load inspection is required only where the building, equipment, storage, or alteration project triggers applicable construction or safety rules.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Direction Générale des Finances Publiques (DGFiP), official portal https://www.impots.gouv.fr/
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Foreign entities register for SIREN/SIRET via guichet-entreprises.fr and obtain VAT ID (FR + 11 digits) through impots.gouv.fr; requires incorporation documents, legal address, and beneficial ownership information
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box elections available; French SARL subject to mandatory entity-level corporate income tax (IS). Limited micro-entreprise regime for qualifying small entities; no hybrid mismatch elections

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: 85,000 EUR annual turnover for service providers (33,000 EUR for goods)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory real-time e-invoicing for all B2B transactions since October 2024; integration with PEPES platform required; digital horodatage stamping and API reporting mandatory for large taxpayers

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: 0% VAT rate for exports of goods or services to non-EU customers; eligibility requires proof of export or offshore delivery, customer location verification, and no taxable domestic supply
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration, Bill of Lading, Inward Remittance Certificate
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Administrative penalties up to 80% of evaded VAT plus interest; retrospective clawback of zero-rating benefits if export proof not provided within 5 years; criminal sanctions for fraudulent claims

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banque de France (BdF), together with the Autorité de Contrôle Prudentiel et de Résolution (ACPR) for banking and EMI licensing, the Directorate General of the Treasury (DG Trésor) for financial sanctions and exchange-control policy, and the European Central Bank (ECB) for euro-area monetary policy. France is a euro-area member; the domestic currency is the euro (EUR).
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: France has full current-account convertibility and substantially free capital-account convertibility. The euro is freely convertible. No prior exchange-control authorisation is required for inbound equity capital, shareholder loans, dividends/profit remittances, royalties, service fees, or outbound trade settlements, provided AML/CFT, sanctions, transfer-pricing, withholding-tax, and statistical reporting rules are satisfied. Profit remittance from a French SARL to a non-resident parent is permitted after corporate income tax and applicable dividend withholding tax (domestic rate generally 25%, subject to treaty or EU Parent-Subsidiary Directive relief). Banks may request contracts, invoices, shareholder resolutions, tax residency certificates, and substance evidence but cannot impose exchange-control approval.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: No statutory surrender or mandatory conversion requirement applies to export receipts. A French resident company may retain foreign-currency export proceeds in domestic or foreign-currency accounts. Bank of France statistical reporting applies to certain cross-border flows and balances under the 'déclaration des opérations avec l'étranger' regime, usually through the servicing bank. No fixed conversion ratio or repatriation deadline exists; documentation must support VAT, corporate income tax, and transfer-pricing compliance.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Crédit Agricole Corporate and Investment Bank / Crédit Agricole S.A.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: High for operational EUR collection and payout accounts through ACPR-licensed or passported EMIs (e.g., Qonto, Revolut Business, Wise Europe) under PSD2. Low for statutory SARL capital escrow, because French law requires share capital to be deposited with a bank, notary, or the Caisse des Dépôts et Consignations, not an EMI. Offshore digital EMIs without French/EU passporting cannot issue French IBANs or hold regulated capital deposits. EMIs are suitable for Stripe payouts, SEPA direct debits, and multi-currency liquidity, subject to enhanced AML/KYC and concentration-risk controls.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Remote onboarding is permitted under French AML/CFT rules if identity is verified by qualified electronic means (eIDAS-compliant video KYC, certified copies, or notarised/apostilled documents). Many tier-1 banks require at least one in-person or video interview with the legal representative, UBO, or managing director for SARL account opening and capital escrow. Non-resident directors may be asked to attend a branch or use a notary. A French registered office, Kbis, statuts, UBO register (RBE) filing, and source-of-funds evidence are typically mandatory.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Complex, layered, or nominee ownership structure or offshore holding chain
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified corporate charters, share registers, notarised/apostilled ownership certificates, UBO declarations, RBE extract, trust/nominee disclosure, tax residency certificates, and source-of-wealth affidavits.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Non-resident directors or UBOs located in FATF grey/black-listed or high-risk jurisdictions
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Enhanced due diligence file, sanctions screening reports, local counsel legal opinion, proof of economic substance, tax compliance certificates, and board resolutions explaining the cross-border structure.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Software/cloud business with high-risk merchant categories, crypto exposure, or chargeback risk
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: AML/CFT program, customer due diligence policies, terms of service, chargeback/refund data, PCI DSS attestation, software licenses, and merchant underwriting records.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Inbound capital or shareholder loan disproportionate to declared share capital or business plan
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Notarised capital-deposit certificate, capital increase/shareholder resolutions, loan agreements, valuation or audit reports, bank reference letters, and source-of-funds documentation.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: PEP involvement or politically exposed person nexus
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: PEP declaration, source-of-wealth and source-of-funds evidence, senior management approval, enhanced monitoring records, and adverse media screening report.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Sanctions or embargo exposure through ownership, customers, or payment routes
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Sanctions screening reports, ownership/control analysis, no-hit certifications, legal opinion on asset freeze and sectoral sanctions, and transaction-level compliance sign-off.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Use SEPA Credit Transfer (SCT) in EUR from EU/EEA banks or SWIFT MT103 / ISO 20022 pacs.008 for non-EU wires. Remittance information (Field 70 or ISO purpose code) must state /CAPI/ for share capital, /INTC/ for intra-company funding, /LOAN/ for shareholder loan, or /DIVI/ for dividends. Include notary capital-deposit certificate, statuts, shareholder resolution, Kbis, and loan/invoice agreement. Beneficiary account is the French SARL account. The bank may verify source of funds, UBO chain, and tax residence. Capital escrow funds remain blocked until RCS registration; after Kbis, transfer to the operational account. Avoid structuring, third-party payments, and crypto rails.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: SEPA Credit Transfer for EUR payments to EU suppliers; SWIFT MT103 for non-EU trade settlements; SWIFT MT202 COV for bank-to-bank cover; Commercial Letter of Credit (MT700/MT760) for large cross-border procurement; documentary collections (MT400/MT410) where appropriate; Stripe Billing and SEPA Direct Debit for customer collections. Include invoice, contract, customs/transport documents for goods; for software services, include invoice and service agreement. Sanctions screening and VAT/transfer-pricing documentation are required.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Deliverable FX forwards (EUR/USD, EUR/GBP, EUR/CHF, EUR/JPY) for contracted exposures
Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) for restricted or non-convertible currencies (e.g., CNY, INR, BRL, KRW)
Cross-currency swaps for term funding, asset-liability matching, and long-dated capital exposures
FX swaps for short-term liquidity and rollover management
Vanilla FX options, collars, and participating forwards for contingent or tender-driven exposures
Currency-overlay mandates with tier-1 banks under EMIR-compliant documentation (ISDA, CSA, and French law netting opinions)

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Corporate Tax Return and Chiffre d'Affaires Declaration
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: 2 months after fiscal year-end (e.g., 2 March for calendar year ending 31 December)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Penalties of 0.5% of turnover per month of delay, capped at 5% of turnover, plus administrative strike-off risk after three months of non-compliance

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Filing of Annual Accounts (Bilan and Compte de Résultat)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registre du Commerce et des Sociétés (RCS) via Greffe
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Administrative fine up to 1,500 EUR and risk of company dissolution for persistent non-compliance

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Update of Ultimate Beneficial Owner (UBO) and Shareholding Registers
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registre des Bénéficiaires Effectifs (RBE) at Greffe
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within one month of any change in UBO or shareholding structure
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Fine up to 10,000 EUR and potential administrative strike-off

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Mandatory independent audit if annual turnover exceeds 800,000 EUR or total assets exceed 400,000 EUR

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Annual confirmation of UBO and shareholding structure required; updates mandatory within one month of any shareholding transfer or change in beneficial ownership
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Registre des actes de cession de parts sociales

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: 0 USD (company-registered office) to 200-500 USD (outsourced registered agent services)
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: 0 USD (no audit required) to 5,000-10,000 USD (when mandatory audit applies)

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 25% (standard French corporate income tax - impôt sur les sociétés - for fiscal years beginning on or after 1 January 2022)
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Reduced CIT rate of 15% on the first EUR 42,500 of taxable profit for eligible SMEs (turnover < EUR 10 million, 75% owned by individuals). R&D tax credit (Crédit d'Impôt Recherche): 30% of qualifying R&D expenses up to EUR 100 million, 5% above EUR 100 million. Jeune Entreprise Innovante (JEI) status: full CIT exemption for the first profitable year and 50% exemption for the second profitable year (qualifying R&D expenses ≥ 30% of total expenses). Patent box (régime de la propriété industrielle): 10% effective rate on net qualifying IP income under the OECD/Nexus-aligned regime. Tax loss carryforward: unlimited carryforward allowed under Article 209 CGI (coded 999 in schema field), subject to the annual cap mechanism of EUR 1,000,000 plus 50% of the taxable profit exceeding EUR 1,000,000; carryback (report en arrière) of losses permitted for one fiscal year, capped at EUR 1,000,000, producing a refundable tax credit over 5 years.
